proof_boundary: A nonnegative integer times a square is at least 0. The pairing 1*(-1)+(-1)*1 equals -2, so t*(-2) is strictly negative when t is greater than 0 and is 0 when t is 0. Complete positivity and Stinespring stay outside this module.
